push.title: Napravi: Malina
push.body: Druga vitrina, treća polica je skoro prazna.

brief.title: The brief
text: Running out of a flavour in the display case means lost sales. The shop wanted a tablet behind the counter that knows what is in the cases and warns the kitchen in time.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the Android tablet app in Java.
Modelled two display cases with seven shelves each, with a flavour on every shelf.
Stored the stock in Firestore and sent notifications with FCM about which flavour to make.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: The counter and the kitchen see the same stock, and the kitchen knows what to make next.
